landingPage.heroTitle: Launch UI landing page template for your product
landingPage.heroDescription: An open-source Next.js and shadcn/ui landing page with a hero mockup, features, pricing and FAQ, deployed on Hostinger at a reviewed version.
landingPage.about: Launch UI is a free, open-source landing page template for software products, built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. It gives a new product a polished first page without starting from a blank canvas. A large headline and product mockup lead into a grid of feature cards, a strip of headline numbers, a three-tier pricing table, an FAQ and a closing call to action. Light and dark themes are built in, and every section is a React component you can rewrite, reorder or remove. Replace the copy and links with your own before you launch. Hostinger deploys the original project at a version we have checked, with its MIT license.

features.title: Hero with product mockup
features.description: A bold headline, two calls to action and a frame for your product screenshot.

features.title: Feature grid
features.description: Eight feature cards with icons to explain what your product does.

features.title: Stats strip
features.description: Headline numbers that add social proof right below the features.

features.title: Pricing table
features.description: Three plans side by side, each with its features and a call to action.

features.title: FAQ accordion
features.description: Answers to common questions in a compact, expandable list.

features.title: Light and dark themes
features.description: A theme that follows the visitor's system setting, in light or dark.
